name: prompt-translate
description: Translate whatever you type in the prompt box into one target language before it reaches the model, keeping code, paths and @file mentions verbatim.

language.title: Target language
language.description: The language every prompt is sent to the model in, e.g. English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese.

model.title: Translation model
model.description: Optional cheaper model for translating (an alias or full id). Empty: the session's own model.

enabled.title: On at session start
enabled.description: Whether translation is on when a session starts; /translate on|off changes it for the session.

engine.title: Translation engine
engine.description: model: your Claude Code model translates (default). google: Google Cloud Translation, which needs googleApiKey; prompts then go to Google.

googleApiKey.title: Google Cloud Translation API key
googleApiKey.description: Only for engine google. Kept in secure storage, sent to Google in a request header.
